profile.name: Quinn
profile.roleZh: 土木系 營建管理組碩士班二年級
profile.intro: Third-year architecture student at National Taiwan University of Science and Technology. I design spaces that bring people together — hostels, campus buildings, churches and museums — modelled in Revit and visualised in Lumion.
about: I'm Quinn (楊沁怡), originally from Myanmar and now studying in the Department of Architecture at NTUST in Taipei. I enjoy designing places where people meet and feel at home — from a youth hostel shaped like two clasped hands to a church that celebrates morning light.
Outside the studio I've served as president of the Myanmar Students Association in Taiwan and now advise its new committee.

projects.title: Zhongshan International Youth Hostel
projects.meta: Zhongshan District, Taipei · Youth hostel · 6 floors + basement

sections.heading: Concept — Holding Hands
sections.text: Two hands clasped together: one person needs both hands to be strong, and a group is stronger still. The handshake shapes the building's exterior. Inside, guests can rest on their own or share space with friends.

sections.heading: Site & Design
sections.text: A 4–6 minute walk from Zhongshan and Shuanglian MRT stations, among shops, hotels and food streets. Curtain-wall glazing brings in daylight and air, and planted terraces on every level give the building warmth.

gallery.alt: Aerial corner view of the hostel
Interior of a shared dormitory room

projects.title: Glory Building — NTUST Digital Construction Center
projects.titleZh: 光榮大樓 台科大數位構築中心

sections.heading: Concept — The Graduation Cap
sections.text: The glazed cylindrical core — the "crown" of a graduation cap — is the daylit heart of the building, while the two wings on either side hold teaching and research spaces.

sections.heading: Programme
sections.text: Lobby, administration, R&D studios, workshops, discussion rooms, undergraduate studios, a photography area, library and multi-purpose rooms, organised around campus walkways and plazas.

gallery.alt: Aerial site view of Glory Building

projects.title: Dawn Light Church
projects.titleZh: 曦光教堂 · 都市中的宗教建築
projects.meta: Aiguo W. Rd. & Guangzhou St., Taipei · Religious architecture in the city

sections.heading: Concept — Light
sections.text: The design celebrates morning light and its everyday changes. When people are under pressure or walking through darkness, a church should be the first place they think of — a pure, bright place.

sections.heading: A Place of Warmth
sections.text: A central courtyard ties together classrooms, an auditorium and the main sanctuary, giving anyone who comes a warm and bright home.

projects.title: Anping Fishery & Fish Exhibition Hall
projects.titleZh: 3D互動 – 安平漁與魚展覽館 · 溯源地域 融合未來
projects.meta: East side of Anping Harbour, Tainan · Museum

sections.heading: Concept — Water
sections.text: Anping Harbour cannot be separated from water — its fishery and its fish live in and on it — so the building's form is drawn from the shapes of waves.

sections.heading: Façade & Light
sections.text: Spheres on the façade represent water droplets, letting light filter inside. Reflecting pools make the building appear to float. Inside: a 3D interactive fish zone, exhibitions, a water-curtain pool and a seafood restaurant.
